response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and developer-tooling credentials, but the role requires deep hardware/architecture expertise — SoC and IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. The closest adjacent experience is low-latency service work in DLang at Sociomantic, some C/C++ at National Instruments, and peripheral robotics/embedded exposure at Altom, which is far from principal-level silicon performance architecture. Education (BS Computer Science) meets the 8+ years threshold in years, but the experience is not in a relevant technical domain. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, including staff/senior roles
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec in DLang)
Some systems-level C/C++ exposure and embedded/robotics adjacency
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design skills
No AI accelerator / GPU workload analysis experience
Strong general engineering seniority and low-latency systems work
